# WE CARE TO MAKE THE WORLD A HEALTHIER AND SAFER PLACE

## A worldwide provider of X-ray imaging systems for medical, non-destructive testing and precision
## contract coating services for a wide range of industrial, medical and electronic applications.



[ Medical Imaging ][61] [ Non-Destructive Testing ][62] [ Contract Manufacturing ][63]

## Innovation. Quality. Trust.

**Carestream is a vibrant global company with a proven history of superb imaging technology and
unparalleled service.**

That history is now poised to continue, creating imaging solutions that provide our customers with
quantifiable gains and real-world benefits. Carestream has always been here for you. We always will
be. Together, let’s continue to shape the future of imaging.
* [Board of Directors][64]
* [Executive Biographies][65]
* [Company History][66]
* [Company Profile (PDF)][67]

## Feature Spotlight

**[Smart Noise Cancellation for Superb Image Quality.][68]**

[ [Quality Solutions Built to Address Real Voice of Customer Needs] ][69]

**Provides clear, easier-to-read images for improved diagnostic confidence.**

Enables customers to lower radiation dose without loss in image quality. Performance validated in an
internal study with **50%** dose reduction from 220 IEC EI on average.*

[Learn More][70]

[Smart Noise Cancellation Brochure (PDF)][71]

## Latest Press Release

**Rochester, NY. May 21, 2026**

[ [Carestream Highlights Continued Business Momentum and Confidence] ][72]

**Carestream Highlights Continued Business Momentum and Confidence**


Following a comprehensive refinancing earlier this year, Carestream Health has received an upgrade
of its Corporate Family Rating and its outlook from Moody’s. The update reflects [[...][73]]
* [Read the full Release][74]
* [All News Releases][75]

* These statements were validated using Carestream CsI detectors in reader studies conducted by
board-certified radiologists. Pairwise comparisons were performed between images at nominal exposure
dose without SNC and at 50% reduced dose with SNC. The reduced-dose images included live patient
images with simulated dose reduction, as well as images of human cadavers and anthropomorphic
phantoms obtained using actual reduced-dose X-ray exposures. SNC performance was further confirmed
using a CDRAD phantom. IEC EI values on average at nominal and reduced dose were 220 and 110,
respectively.

## X-rays.

*By Ann London BS. RT (R)(T) | Clinical Applications Specialist, Carestream*

The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s National Institute for Occupational Safety and
Health (NIOSH) is deciding on expanding their federal program known as the “B Reader Program.” This
program trains and certifies physicians to read chest radiographs […]

[Read the full blog][77]

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

# Nobody does
# adaptive
# like **Elekta**

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

Your browser does not support HTML video..

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

[About us][233]

# One platform, INFINITT possibilities.

INFINITT Healthcare is a global developer of Enterprise Imaging solutions, operating in 56 countries
on five continents. Start delivering better, value-based care today with our centralized imaging
technology.

[Get Started][37]

## INFINITT Digital Pathology Solution (IDPS)

Our IDPS workflow is scanner agnostic with options for local and cloud data solutions. IDPS was also
among our solutions that played a part in the FIRST IN THE WORLD – HIMSS DIAM Stage 7 Accreditation
for a major, cutting-edge medical campus. See how our image-based information environment can
transform your lab workflow.

[Get Started][38]

# INFINITT PACS 7.0

Our fast and powerful diagnostic viewer, is built to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) to
enhance reading workflow, to support diagnostic accuracy and to enrich the user experience.

[Get Started][39]

# INFINITT Multi-disciplinary Team (MDT)

Workflow software with patient-centered integrated worklist, enables physicians to view images and
documents from all departments. Optimized communication tools and screen sharing to support
telemedicine.

[Get Started][40]

# Images on any internet-connected device.

With INFINITT software, images and reports can be viewed anywhere, anytime, and on a variety of
devices. Patient consults, remote reading, clinical review; all are possible within a single
framework.

[Get Started][41]


INFINITT Cardiology Suite, a web-based PACS and reporting system for cardiology and vascular
imaging, EKG and nuclear medicine, integrates all your cardiovascular data into one solution.

[Learn More][42]


INFINITT Digital Pathology Solution (IDPS) enables quantitative image analysis and remote reading
for secondary consult and multi-disciplinary review. Facilitates collaboration, research, and the
application of AI.

[Learn More][43]


INFINITT RT PACS, a dedicated Radiotherapy Treatment image and data management solution, is
optimized to streamline workflow for oncologists, physicists, dosimetrists, therapists, and nurses.

[Learn More][44]


## Purpose-built PACS for maximum performance.

INIFITT PACS is our fastest, most-powerful diagnostic viewer, purpose-built to accelerate access and
processing speeds for radiologists. View its award-winning performance features.

[Learn More][45]

## See the Bigger Picture Across All Disciplines.

## Radiology

Discover our #1 award-winning RIS/PACS with advanced visualization, analysis, and reporting.

[Learn More][46]

## Cardiology

See how our state-of-the-art cardiology suite centralizes all cardiovascular data into one solution.

[Learn More][47]

## Pathology

Digitize your entire pathology workflow with solutions designed to improve efficiency and
collaboration.

[Learn More][48]

## Dental

Learn about our Versity Dental platform for academic environments featuring 2D and 3D viewing.

[Learn More][49]

### MORE SOLUTIONS

Explore more INIFINITT solutions, including for advanced clinical and veterinary enterprise imaging.

[Learn More][50]

### Our centralized platform informs value-based care

### Our interoperable technology reduces complexity

### Our service stops at nothing for your satisfaction

We’ve been ranked the Best-in-KLAS Category Leader for the Community Hospital market and Imaging
Center/Ambulatory market. Discover more reasons to choose INFINITT North America.

#### “The situation is funny because everyone is so sold on other products, but those products are
#### awful compared to what I have in INFINITT PACS. For example, it takes me significantly less
#### time to make the same report in INFINITT PACS than it does in other systems. Also, for prior
#### sections, our current study comes up in INFINITT PACS, and the three priors populate the screen
#### just like they do in the other vendors’ products, but INFINITT PACS automatically populates our
#### prior fields. We looked at those priors because we brought them up on the screen, so there is
#### no reason that we should have to open our mouths to tell the voice recognition system that we
#### opened them and looked at them. There are also drop-down menus that I have built, and I can
#### click on a section in my field and select that, and I don’t even have to say a word. Reading in
#### INFINITT PACS is a breath of fresh air. There is a tremendous shortage of radiologists
#### nationwide, so anything that can make me more efficient is better, and INFINITT PACS does
#### that.”

VP/Executive

### “Overall, INFINITT has excellent products. If I were buying the same kind of products today,
### INFINITT’s product would definitely be my leading choice. I try to keep myself up to speed on
### INFINITT’s competition in case we ever decide to switch platforms, but so far, I haven’t seen
### any compelling reason to switch, even if making a switch would be easy. I am very happy with
### INFINITT. The vendor has taken a lot of our feedback and has really incorporated some changes
### that have made the product much more functional for us. The product was really good before, but
### INFINITT has done a better job of upgrading it now.”

Director

### “INFINITT’s support is very good. The vendor does exceedingly well in that area. I have had to
### make very few support calls, but when I do call, someone immediately picks up the phone and is
### on top of the issue. INFINITT’s support portal is very intuitive and easy to use. The support
### people have a large knowledge base, and they guide me in the right direction. We are a hands-on
### organization, so if we can do something without the support team, we will take a shot at it. But
### when we need assistance, someone at INFINITT immediately picks up the case.”

Manager

### “We use a different PACS at another facility, and the difference between that PACS and INFINITT
### PACS is night and day! We have so much flexibility with INFINITT PACS, and it’s the easiest
### product to integrate across facilities. Physicians who use the other PACS are now crying for
### this one!”

**George Jackson** | Operations Manager, Fader Hospital

### “I am an extremely busy radiologist, and I have dealt with many different PACS. When we
### purchased INFINITT PACS, I liked everything about it and never had buyer’s remorse. I couldn’t
### be happier with my decision several years later. I wouldn’t be able to get through my day if I
### were using another PACS. The system is amazing. I don’t have to close my case to be able to open
### another case. The system is unbelievably easy. We have a lot of surgeons who do tons of
### surgeries and send their work to us, and all of them have INFINITT PACS and love it.”

– Physician

### “INFINITT PACS is used for cardiology and radiology. Our physicians could not be happier. The
### PACS has many tools that enable the system to do multiple-department diagnoses of images.
### INFINITT Cardiology Suite is fully integrated with the PACS for imaging and transcription and
### enables us to read and diagnose remotely. The system is very easy to maintain internally, but if
### we have an issue that cannot be resolved internally, INFINITT is very quick to respond and
### resolve the issue.”

– Manager/Analyst

### “I feel that INFINITT PACS is probably the best PACS in the marketplace today. INFINITT
### continues to keep in touch with us. We talk with them on a regular basis, and they ask us what
### enhancements we would like. We have no other vendor that does that. If our physicians need the
### system to be tweaked, then INFINITT is typically very eager to make the necessary changes for
### us. We always have the most current software upgrade. INFINITT is a superb company to work with,
### and we are able to communicate with them from both the bottom up and the top down. I wish I
### could say that for our other vendors.”

– Director/Physician

#### “The situation is funny because everyone is so sold on other products, but those products are
#### awful compared to what I have in INFINITT PACS. For example, it takes me significantly less
#### time to make the same report in INFINITT PACS than it does in other systems. Also, for prior
#### sections, our current study comes up in INFINITT PACS, and the three priors populate the screen
#### just like they do in the other vendors’ products, but INFINITT PACS automatically populates our
#### prior fields. We looked at those priors because we brought them up on the screen, so there is
#### no reason that we should have to open our mouths to tell the voice recognition system that we
#### opened them and looked at them. There are also drop-down menus that I have built, and I can
#### click on a section in my field and select that, and I don’t even have to say a word. Reading in
#### INFINITT PACS is a breath of fresh air. There is a tremendous shortage of radiologists
#### nationwide, so anything that can make me more efficient is better, and INFINITT PACS does
#### that.”

VP/Executive

### “Overall, INFINITT has excellent products. If I were buying the same kind of products today,
### INFINITT’s product would definitely be my leading choice. I try to keep myself up to speed on
### INFINITT’s competition in case we ever decide to switch platforms, but so far, I haven’t seen
### any compelling reason to switch, even if making a switch would be easy. I am very happy with
### INFINITT. The vendor has taken a lot of our feedback and has really incorporated some changes
### that have made the product much more functional for us. The product was really good before, but
### INFINITT has done a better job of upgrading it now.”

Director

### “INFINITT’s support is very good. The vendor does exceedingly well in that area. I have had to
### make very few support calls, but when I do call, someone immediately picks up the phone and is
### on top of the issue. INFINITT’s support portal is very intuitive and easy to use. The support
### people have a large knowledge base, and they guide me in the right direction. We are a hands-on
### organization, so if we can do something without the support team, we will take a shot at it. But
### when we need assistance, someone at INFINITT immediately picks up the case.”

Manager

### “We use a different PACS at another facility, and the difference between that PACS and INFINITT
### PACS is night and day! We have so much flexibility with INFINITT PACS, and it’s the easiest
### product to integrate across facilities. Physicians who use the other PACS are now crying for
### this one!”

**George Jackson** | Operations Manager, Fader Hospital

### “I am an extremely busy radiologist, and I have dealt with many different PACS. When we
### purchased INFINITT PACS, I liked everything about it and never had buyer’s remorse. I couldn’t
### be happier with my decision several years later. I wouldn’t be able to get through my day if I
### were using another PACS. The system is amazing. I don’t have to close my case to be able to open
### another case. The system is unbelievably easy. We have a lot of surgeons who do tons of
### surgeries and send their work to us, and all of them have INFINITT PACS and love it.”

– Physician

### “INFINITT PACS is used for cardiology and radiology. Our physicians could not be happier. The
### PACS has many tools that enable the system to do multiple-department diagnoses of images.
### INFINITT Cardiology Suite is fully integrated with the PACS for imaging and transcription and
### enables us to read and diagnose remotely. The system is very easy to maintain internally, but if
### we have an issue that cannot be resolved internally, INFINITT is very quick to respond and
### resolve the issue.”

– Manager/Analyst

### “I feel that INFINITT PACS is probably the best PACS in the marketplace today. INFINITT
### continues to keep in touch with us. We talk with them on a regular basis, and they ask us what
### enhancements we would like. We have no other vendor that does that. If our physicians need the
### system to be tweaked, then INFINITT is typically very eager to make the necessary changes for

– Director/Physician

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

enhancing the patient experience, enabling more personalized care, streamlining clinical workflows,

# ANTS

AdvancedNeuroimagingTechnologicalSolutions

From study design and data processing to statistical analysis and interpretation — your full-service
research partner in neuroimaging.

[Schedule a Free Consultation][8][Explore Our Services][9]

INSIGHTBridging imaging, AI, and clinical research.

About Us

## The Imaging Expertise Your Research Deserves

At ANTS, we are dedicated to empowering our clients to advance the field of neuroimaging. As
research consultants, we deliver robust data processing solutions that enhance the utility of
advanced neuroimaging — enabling more accurate prognostication and improved therapeutic delivery.

Whether you need help designing a study, processing diffusion or functional MRI data, running the
right statistical analyses, or interpreting your results — our team of physician-scientists and
engineers works alongside you at every step.

[ANTS LLC logo — an ant head with neural circuit patterns]

What We Do

## Our Neuroimaging Services

End-to-end support for neuroimaging data — from collection to insight.

### Data Analysis & AI Solutions

ML/AI-powered analysis, statistical modeling, and advanced signal processing to extract meaningful
insights from complex neuroimaging data.
* Machine Learning
* AI
* Statistical Modeling
* Signal Processing

### Pipeline Development

Automated, reproducible data processing pipelines built for scale. Cloud-native workflows that take
you from raw acquisition to publication-ready results.
* Automation
* Cloud-Native
* Scalable Workflows

### Imaging Consultation

Expert guidance on study design, acquisition parameter optimization, and methodology review. We help
you ask better questions and build the infrastructure to answer them.
* Study Design
* Methodology
* Parameter Optimization

[Get Started][14]

Our Work

## Featured Projects

A selection of platforms and tools we've built for the neuroimaging community.

### Automated Analysis Platform

Developed a scalable cloud-based platform for automated processing and analysis of large-scale
neuroimaging datasets.
* Cloud Platform
* Automation
* AI

### Clinical Decision Support Tool

Built an ML-powered tool to assist clinicians in interpreting complex imaging data for improved
patient outcomes.
* Machine Learning
* Clinical
* Decision Support

### Multi-Site Data Pipeline

Engineered a robust data processing pipeline supporting multi-site research studies with harmonized
imaging protocols.
* Pipeline
* Multi-Site
* Data Harmonization

### Research Analytics Dashboard

Created an interactive visualization platform for exploring and analyzing processed neuroimaging
results across studies.
* Visualization
* Analytics
* Dashboard

[View All Projects][15]

Our Team

## Meet the Experts

A multidisciplinary team of physician-scientists and engineers united by a passion for advancing
neuroimaging.

[Mahdi Alizadeh, PhD]

### Mahdi Alizadeh, PhD

Chief Executive Officer

Leads project feasibility assessment and strategic direction with deep expertise in imaging physics
and research design.

Read full bio→
[Mashaal Syed, MS]

### Mashaal Syed, MS

Chief Science Officer

Drives innovation and research design with specialization in functional connectivity, connectomics,
and neuroprosthetics.

Read full bio→
[Amir Aghdam, MS]

### Amir Aghdam, MS

Chief Technology Officer

Leads ML/AI research and software development, building the intelligent systems and infrastructure
that power ANTS.

Read full bio→
[Isaiah Ailes, MD]

### Isaiah Ailes, MD

Chief Operating Officer

Oversees operations and client correspondence, bringing extensive training in diagnostic radiology
and business strategy.

Read full bio→

## Level Up Your Imaging Expertise

Hands-on programs designed for researchers and clinicians who want to master neuroimaging analysis

Built for researchers and clinicians — want a seat when the doors open?

About Us

## The Imaging Expertise Your Research Deserves

At ANTS, we are dedicated to empowering our clients to advance the field of neuroimaging. As
research consultants, we deliver robust data processing solutions that enhance the utility of
advanced neuroimaging — enabling more accurate prognostication and improved therapeutic delivery.

Whether you need help designing a study, processing diffusion or functional MRI data, running the
right statistical analyses, or interpreting your results — our team of physician-scientists and
engineers works alongside you at every step.

[ANTS LLC logo — an ant head with neural circuit patterns]

What We Do

## Our Neuroimaging Services

End-to-end support for neuroimaging data — from collection to insight.

### Data Analysis & AI Solutions

ML/AI-powered analysis, statistical modeling, and advanced signal processing to extract meaningful
insights from complex neuroimaging data.
* Machine Learning
* AI
* Statistical Modeling
* Signal Processing

### Pipeline Development

Automated, reproducible data processing pipelines built for scale. Cloud-native workflows that take
you from raw acquisition to publication-ready results.
* Automation
* Cloud-Native
* Scalable Workflows

### Imaging Consultation

Expert guidance on study design, acquisition parameter optimization, and methodology review. We help
you ask better questions and build the infrastructure to answer them.
* Study Design
* Methodology
* Parameter Optimization

[Get Started][14]

Our Work

## Featured Projects

A selection of platforms and tools we've built for the neuroimaging community.

### Automated Analysis Platform

Developed a scalable cloud-based platform for automated processing and analysis of large-scale
neuroimaging datasets.
* Cloud Platform
* Automation
* AI

### Clinical Decision Support Tool

Built an ML-powered tool to assist clinicians in interpreting complex imaging data for improved
patient outcomes.
* Machine Learning
* Clinical
* Decision Support

### Multi-Site Data Pipeline

Engineered a robust data processing pipeline supporting multi-site research studies with harmonized
imaging protocols.
* Pipeline
* Multi-Site
* Data Harmonization

### Research Analytics Dashboard

Created an interactive visualization platform for exploring and analyzing processed neuroimaging
results across studies.
* Visualization
* Analytics
* Dashboard

Arzneimitteltherapie is committed to advancing scientific knowledge and clinical practice in the
fields of pharmacology, toxicology, and rational drug therapy. The journal aims to provide
high-quality, up-to-date, and practice-oriented content for physicians, pharmacists, researchers,
and nursing professionals. It focuses on publishing the latest developments in drug therapy,
presenting results from clinical studies and pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic research, and
analyzing the safety, efficacy, and tolerability of pharmaceutical treatments. In addition, the
journal addresses drug interactions and the optimization of therapeutic strategies, promoting the
exchange of knowledge between researchers and practitioners. Arzneimitteltherapie serves as a
reliable platform for scientific articles, clinical reviews, practical guidelines, and expert
opinions, all designed to improve the quality of pharmacotherapy and healthcare outcomes.

## Ivan Đikić: Science, Innovation, and the Fight Against Disease

Professor Ivan Đikić, a world-renowned scientist from Goethe University Frankfurt, shares insights
into his groundbreaking research on the molecular foundations of human diseases. His pioneering work
focuses on the ubiquitin system — a critical regulator of protein quality control and immune
function. Defects in this system are linked to major health challenges, including cancer,
Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease, and immune disorders. Professor Đikić is also a leading
voice in the development of precision medicine, advocating for the integration of genomics and
molecular signaling to create more effective, personalized therapies. He emphasizes the need to make
advanced treatments accessible to all and inspires young scientists to embrace interdisciplinary
collaboration and innovation in research.

Journal E-mail:** [arzneimitteltherapie@inbox.eu][25]
**Paper Publication Fee:** 1500 USD
Arzneimitteltherapie is committed to advancing scientific knowledge and clinical practice in the
fields of pharmacology, toxicology, and rational drug therapy. The journal aims to provide
high-quality, up-to-date, and practice-oriented content for physicians, pharmacists, researchers,
and nursing professionals. It focuses on publishing the latest developments in drug therapy,
presenting results from clinical studies and pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic research, and
analyzing the safety, efficacy, and tolerability of pharmaceutical treatments. In addition, the
journal addresses drug interactions and the optimization of therapeutic strategies, promoting the
exchange of knowledge between researchers and practitioners. Arzneimitteltherapie serves as a
reliable platform for scientific articles, clinical reviews, practical guidelines, and expert
opinions, all designed to improve the quality of pharmacotherapy and healthcare outcomes.

## Announcement

**Call for Papers for the New Issue.
****Last Date of Submission:** March 1^{st}, 2026

## Ivan Đikić: Science, Innovation, and the Fight Against Disease

Professor Ivan Đikić, a world-renowned scientist from Goethe University Frankfurt, shares insights
into his groundbreaking research on the molecular foundations of human diseases. His pioneering work
focuses on the ubiquitin system — a critical regulator of protein quality control and immune
function. Defects in this system are linked to major health challenges, including cancer,
Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease, and immune disorders. Professor Đikić is also a leading
voice in the development of precision medicine, advocating for the integration of genomics and
molecular signaling to create more effective, personalized therapies. He emphasizes the need to make
advanced treatments accessible to all and inspires young scientists to embrace interdisciplinary
collaboration and innovation in research.

# [Advancing][93]

# [Neuroimaging][94]



## Global Community, Shared Mission

The American Society of Neuroimaging (ASN) has advanced education, certification, and collaboration
in neuroimaging since 1977, representing clinicians, researchers, and technologists worldwide.

[ Learn More ][95]

# Latest News & Events

What's happening at The American Society of Neuroimaging

### Call for Speakers

The American Society of Neuroimaging (ASN), in partnership with the University of Kentucky
Department of Neurology, is seeking expert volunteer speakers for our upcoming virtual neuroimaging
lecture series designed for Adult and Child Neurology residents.

﻿

[ Sign Up ][96]
[][97]

### Learn

Dr. Laszlo Mechtler and The American Society of Neuroimaging invite you to attend the next of our
bi-weekly Educational Rounds. ﻿

[ Attend Webinar ][98]
[][99]

### Save the Date

The 50th ASN Annual Meeting will take place January 15 - 17, 2027 in Hilton Head Island, SC.


[ Learn more ][100]
[][101]

### Research

Featuring **practice‑focused, peer‑reviewed research**, the journal covers the full spectrum of
imaging modalities—including MRI, CT, PET, SPECT, neurosonology, and ultrasound—along with emerging
technologies and non‑interpretive topics such as wellness and the business of neuroimaging.

[ Latest Issue ][102]
[
][103]

### Annual Meeting

ASN’s Annual Meeting offers education, networking, and celebration of our Society’s achievements.
Explore upcoming events, past programs, and on-demand content.

[ Learn More ][104]

### Become an ASN Member

Join or renew your ASN membership and connect with a global network of neuroimaging professionals.
Flexible membership options, discounts, and special rates available.

[ Learn More ][105]

### Certifications

ASN offers certification exams in Neurosonology (RPNI) and Neurovascular Specialist (NVS) to
recognize advanced expertise and professional achievement.

[ Learn More ][106]

# Large format scanners and imaging matter to us

At Contex we are passionate about creating industry-leading imaging solutions with our large format
scanners. We continuously strive to improve our business practices, products and services to provide
you with the very best.

Delivering world-class large format scanners to over 100 countries, Contex solutions are recognized
by a wide range of industries for reliability, high performance and superb image quality.

software for more than 100 years.

We want to make working with large format originals as easy for you as possible. Making sure that

## What is large format scanning?

In today’s digital age, where information is readily accessible and shareable, businesses and
individuals alike are constantly seeking ways to digitize their valuable physical assets, whether it
be CAD and engineering blueprints, maps and GIS, paintings, artwork and photos, or documents to
archive. This is where large format scanning comes to the forefront.

Join us as we explore the benefits and many applications of large format scanning in this
comprehensive guide.

## Understanding CPT Codes 0865T & 0866T

As of **January 1, 2024**, new **Category III CPT codes (0865T, 0866T)** are active
for **AI-assisted quantitative brain MRI analysis**. These codes apply to a variety of vendor
solutions, including **Cortechs.ai,** and serve as an essential step toward achieving permanent
reimbursement.

[ Learn more ][77]
[Cortechs.ai|Home]

## Understanding CPT Codes for Prostate MRI Analysis

Prostate MRI plays a critical role in detecting and evaluating prostate cancer, and the availability
of Category I CPT codes ensures that providers can seek reimbursement for these essential imaging
services.

## Understanding CPT Codes 0865T & 0866T

As of **January 1, 2024**, new **Category III CPT codes (0865T, 0866T)** are active
for **AI-assisted quantitative brain MRI analysis**. These codes apply to a variety of vendor
solutions, including **Cortechs.ai,** and serve as an essential step toward achieving permanent
reimbursement.

[ Learn more ][77]
[Cortechs.ai|Home]

## Understanding CPT Codes for Prostate MRI Analysis

Prostate MRI plays a critical role in detecting and evaluating prostate cancer, and the availability
of Category I CPT codes ensures that providers can seek reimbursement for these essential imaging
services.

### Signal analysis

We offer a wide range of signal analysis options, including software for EEG/ERP analysis,
post-processing of ECG and EMG, electromagnetic source estimation, real-time analysis for display
and real-time analysis for feedback/control in brain-computer interface applications.  We have a
variety of software applications for analysis of pre-recorded EEG/ERP, EMG, MEG, ECG and other
biosignals.  All of our software options are modular so you can license only parts of the software
that you need to accomplish your research goals.  We provide industry leading software for real time

][41]
[
[Electrode localization]

### Electrode localization

You have only one opportunity -- make the most of it! You took the time to position the electrodes
accurately, so it should be worth the time to measure their locations with respect to surface
landmarks to enhance future signal analysis options.  3D locations of electrodes can be used in
co-registration of surface measured physiological signals with anatomical MRI, CT and other imaging
modalities in software applications such as EMSE Suite and others.  Quick and accurate measurement
of 3D electrode positions adds only 3-5 minutes to a typical study, but it ensures precision when
coregistering surface measurements with anatomical images.

Shop Now
][42]
[
[Neuromodulation]

### Neuromodulation

Neuomodulation encompasses a wide variety of technologies for modifying brain activity relatively
non-invasively. **Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) -** a** **method for non-invasive
stimulation of the brain in which a coil is placed near the head, inducing small electric currents
in the region of the brain just under the coil. We offer highly flexible TMS stimulators designed
for research, with or with out concurrent EEG.  TMS is generally used to stimulate centrally, but it
can be used to stimulate peripherally as well. **AREAS OF APPLICATION:** **Neuroscience: ** • Brain
mapping • Functional connectivity of the brain • Motor and sensory functions • Pain • Visual
perception • Mental imagery. **Psychiatry:** • Depression • Anxiety disorders, panic disorder, and
obsessive-compulsive disorder • Schizophrenia • Substance abuse and addiction • Posttraumatic stress
disorder • Autism. **Neurology: ** • Pain • Rehabilitation of aphasia and motor disability after
stroke • Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis • Multiple sclerosis • Epilepsy • Alzheimer's disease •
Parkinson's disease • Brain death, coma, and other persistent vegetative states • Tinnitus.
**Urology: ** • Incontinence.

Shop Now
][43]
[
[Eye-tracking]

### Eye-tracking

Eye-tracking refers to a collection of technologies for sensing where a person is looking (termed
"point of regard").  Eye-tracking is a popular measure in its own regard in research on reading,
visual attention, marketing / advertising and psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia.  We offer
several types of eye-tracking solutions brought to you by Cambridge Research Systems Ltd., including
high frame rate systems up to 500 frames/second, high-precision systems for use inside the fMRI
scanner and affordable systems for simple fixation monitoring in behavioral and ERP applications.
**System Integration** We provide integration assistance with the EEG systems we sell.  If you are
buying an eye-tracker for stand-alone use, let us know your application so we can help you settle on
the best fit.  If you intend to use the eye-tracker with a system you already own that we sell or
support, let us know the serial number of the unit.  If you want the eye-tracker to be provided as
part of a complete laboratory configuration, knowing some details about your application will let us
guide you to the most convenient and cost-effective solution. **Other Ocular Monitoring Methods Not
Considered Eye-Tracking** Note that there are other ways of measuring eye movements that do not
provide enough information to determine point of regard, but those are listed elsewhere in the
site.  For example, electrooculogram (EOG) can be measured with any DC bioamplifier, and it is often
used to detect large movements away from a fixation point, but it is not generally considered
suitable for determining point-of-regard.  Similarly, the Jazz Vigilance Monitor for use with
ActiveTwo monitors ocular motility within the head/socket but due to viscoelasticity, the signal is
not suitable for determining point-of-regard.  Jazz provides a very high frame rate and high
sensitivity, which make it useful for microsaccade detection.

We offer both manual and vocal response devices that are flexible, accurate, and easy to use.

paradigm, or a control input that determines the direction the rest of the experiment will take, we

applications and voice response devices designed specifically for experiments requiring a vocal
response.  We also supply response boxes from Cambridge Research Systems for use in ERP and
Behavioral situations and a fiber optic response system for use in MEG and fMRI made by Current
Designs.

][46]

### Stimulus delivery

Cortech offers software and hardware for experimental control and behavioral response measurement.
 Flexibility is the most requested feature in stimulus delivery and response measurement apparatus.
 We’ve selected software programs and devices that can be computer driven for the ultimate in
flexible stimulus delivery.  Each of these tools can be interfaced with any of our acquisition
systems for measurement of EP’s and ERP’s or they can be used by themselves for behavioral testing.
We offer experimental control and stimulus delivery solutions suitable for users at both expert and
beginner levels.  We also offer hardware for auditory and somatosensory stimulus delivery, constant
current, constant voltage electrical stimulation, and multimodal stimulus control as well as devices
for measuring and marking visual and auditory event timing.

][47]

the degree that the system conforms to some standard interface parameters.  If you are looking for

existing system, chances are you are in the right place.  Sensors that are designed only for use
with a given acquisition system are listed as accessories under that system and are not duplicated
here.

suitable for determining point-of-regard.  Similarly, the Jazz Vigilance Monitor for use with
ActiveTwo monitors ocular motility within the head/socket but due to viscoelasticity, the signal is
not suitable for determining point-of-regard.  Jazz provides a very high frame rate and high
sensitivity, which make it useful for microsaccade detection.

[Background Image]

Reliable and flexible mobile fNIRS designed with no tech debt to meet today's neuroimaging
challenges and those of tomorrow. On Earth and beyond.

Designed for

Our fNIRS hardware and software are designed to support advanced neuroscience research, providing
real-time insights into brain activity. Our portable, non-invasive systems allow researchers to
study cognitive functions, brain connectivity, and hemodynamic responses in a wide range of
environments—from labs to real-world settings.

[ Explore Spectrum 23 Features ][34]

First fNIRS ever used in space successfully for brain activity research. Having been used during the
Ax-2 and Ax-3 missions to the ISS, our system is now a permanent equipment on the International
Space Station, providing invaluable data on brain activity in the unique microgravity environment of
space.

[ Read About fNIRS in Space ][35]

Cortivision offers a range of research services to enhance your use of our fNIRS technology. We
provide expert consultation for protocol design, result interpretation, and experimental setup. Our
training options include basic and advanced online sessions, with tailored support for both
fundamental and advanced functions. We also offer integration with external software, and custom
VR-environment scenarios for specialized research needs.

[ Request a Consultation ][36]

## Recognized by **various industries all over the world **

## Best portable fNIRs

fNIRS technology has a great potential for brain research, but since it requires specialist skills,
and experience, its use today is limited to the scientific world. We believe that by **simplifying
the use of this technology****,** we will make applications in new areas possible while the current
use in science will become much easier and desgned for non-laboratory, mobile conditions.

That’s why everything we build is based on **flexibility of use and user-centered design****.** As a
result, our products respond to the needs of customers in a rich, fast and comfortable way.

That’s why our spectroscopes are used in labs across the globe and were the first ever used in
space.

# Why Cortivision?

Why to choose **precision, flexibility and innovation** in every insight?
* ### Ecosystem
  
  Choose Cortivision for unmatched consistency and integration. We control the entire ecosystem,
  from hardware to software, ensuring seamless performance and reliability without dependence on
  external suppliers & licensing. We offer all that is needed for research.

  Choose Cortivision for excellence from the ground up. As scientists & businessmen we build on
  others' mistakes, avoiding technical debt, and choosing future-oriented solutions to treat every
  scientist as a first-class customer.
* ### Functional approach
  
  Choose Cortivision for simplification. We lower barriers and streamline technology, avoiding
  outdated solutions, which enables new applications. Experience our approach that makes complex
  research light and opens doors to spectrum of possibilities.

Station across multiple missions. Most recently, the ISS crew successfully completed the PhotonGrav
experiment during Axiom Mission 4 (2025), demonstrating reliable brain-computer interface operation
in microgravity and advancing the future of optical neurotechnology for space exploration.

# Why Cortivision?

Why to choose **precision, flexibility and innovation** in every insight?
* ### Ecosystem
  
  Choose Cortivision for unmatched consistency and integration. We control the entire ecosystem,
  from hardware to software, ensuring seamless performance and reliability without dependence on
  external suppliers & licensing. We offer all that is needed for research.
* ### Excellence at origin
  
  Choose Cortivision for excellence from the ground up. As scientists & businessmen we build on
  others' mistakes, avoiding technical debt, and choosing future-oriented solutions to treat every
  scientist as a first-class customer.
* ### Functional approach
  
  Choose Cortivision for simplification. We lower barriers and streamline technology, avoiding
  outdated solutions, which enables new applications. Experience our approach that makes complex
  research light and opens doors to spectrum of possibilities.

## From the Lab to Low Earth Orbit

Cortivision's fNIRS technology has supported neuroscience research aboard the International Space
Station across multiple missions. Most recently, the ISS crew successfully completed the PhotonGrav
experiment during Axiom Mission 4 (2025), demonstrating reliable brain-computer interface operation
in microgravity and advancing the future of optical neurotechnology for space exploration.

# Research

Sleep fulfills vital functions for the brain and body. However, sleep is not a uniform state:
alternating substates and oscillation patterns show rich variations on different time scales. In the
Sleep & Memory Lab, based at the [Donders Institute][8] in Nijmegen, The Netherlands, we aim to
uncover the mechanisms behind this variability and their specific role in the functions of sleep. We
are particularly interested in the following topics:

─────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[sle│[**Sleep physiology.**][10] From an evolutionary point of view, spending hours in a           
ep]][│non-responsive state seems strikingly non-adaptive. Sleep thus serves several vital functions 
9]   │to overcompensate for this disadvantage. In our lab, we develop new strategies to understand  
     │the structure of sleep on the micro- (sleep stages and microprocesses), meso- (sleep cycles), 
     │and macro-level (sleep regularity), with the aim to map the richness of sleep physiology to   
     │the different functions of sleep.                                                             
─────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[cli│[**Clinical applications.**][12] Sleep disturbances are the leading transdiagnostic symptom of
nical│and likely causal contributor to the development of psychiatric and neurological diseases. We 
]][11│focus in particular on two areas of mental health to help translate sleep research insights   
]    │into clinical applications and health care innovations: How is sleep involved stress-related  
     │disorders, and how is brain clearance during sleep impaired in neurodegenerative diseases?    
─────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[met│[**Sleep research methods.**][14] Polysomnography as the gold standard in sleep research      
hods]│generates rich and multimodal datasets. However, considering the massive costs and thus       
][13]│resulting small sample sizes of this method, we help to transfer sleep research from          
     │small-scale lab environments to large-scale clinical and home settings. We develop and        
     │validate new tools for the recording and analysis of sleep data, from minimal sleep EEG       
     │headbands to analysis pipelines for big sleep data.                                           
─────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[luc│[**Dreaming.**][16] Conscious experience fluctuates considerably across the sleep-wake cycle: 
id   │alert attention alternates with mind wandering, sleep onset imagery, dreamless sleep and vivid
dream│dreaming. We study consciousness during sleep, considering the phenomenon of lucid dreaming   
ing]]│particularly interesting as both a model case and tool. In addition to fundamental insights   
[15] │into the functions and neural correlates of dreaming, we develop and validate different dream 
     │engineering strategies to modulate dream experiences.                                         
─────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[mne│[**Memory.**][18] Memory skills differ across the general population – from age-related memory
monic│decline to the outstanding feats of memory champions. In addition to the role of sleep in     
s]][1│memory processing, we investigate different strategies of learning and memory enhancement,    
7]   │with a focus on the mnemonic training strategies used in memory sports. Beyond the efficacy of
     │mnemonics in naïve subjects, developmental contexts and age-related decline, we are           
     │particularly interested in the neural mechanisms underlying mnemonic training and superior    
     │memory skills.                                                                                
─────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[Participate in our studies!][19]

][68][ [This Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) scientist was performing one of the
last steps in a poliovirus testing process. Dyes are used to determine, which of the nucleotides
(basis of genetic material) are present in a sequence. The outer coat of the virus (the capsid) is
sequenced to find out where the virus has circulated. This machine is a sequencing instrument, a
Sanger sequencer. Sanger sequencing implements a traditional type of sequencing. The plates go in,
and the machine analyzes the reactions. Each base has a different color. The machine processes the
bases, and sorts them, producing a chromatogram of four colors. See PHIL 22909 for an example of
this four-color chromatogram. Sequencing gives CDC a window to where a virus has been, and how long
it has been circulating. This allows CDC to focus our vaccination programs on specific regions
inside pertinent countries.]

Every day, researchers are transforming lives and protecting our planet, one study at a time. Each
breakthrough, discovery, and citation helps science move forward.

Our role is to help that research travel: reach more readers, get cited, find new collaborations,
and find the audiences that can act on it.

This year, 146 of the journals we publish have received a Journal Impact Factor and 160 have a
CiteScore, placing them as the most influential in their fields. See more about how your work is
making an impact.

## Frequently asked questions
* 01
  
  ### What is icometrix and what solutions does it offer?
  
  icometrix provides **AI-powered brain imaging solutions** for neurological disorders. Its
  portfolio is designed to help improve care in dementia and Alzheimer’s disease, multiple
  sclerosis, ARIA detection, brain trauma, stroke, epilepsy, tumors, and Parkinson’s disease.. The
  icometrix solutions **automatically detect, segment, and quantify brain structures and lesions**
  to support clinicians and researchers.
* 02
  
  ### How does icobrain AI help in brain imaging for neurological disorders?
  
  icobrain performs **automated detection and volumetric quantification** of lesions and brain
  structures, enabling clinicians to **monitor disease progression, evaluate treatment response, and
  make informed decisions**.
* 03
  
  ### Which neurological conditions can be analyzed with icobrain?
  
  icobrain supports analysis for **dementia & Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, stroke, traumatic
  brain injury, epilepsy, Parkinson’s disease, brain tumors, and ARIA monitoring**
* 04
  
  ### How does icobrain integrate with hospital workflows and PACS/EMR systems?
  
  Using **icobridge**, icobrain connects MRI scanners, PACS, and EMR systems. This enables **secure
  data transfer, automated report generation**, and clinician-friendly dashboards, streamlining the
  workflow.
* 05
  
  ### Is icobrain FDA-cleared or clinically validated?
  
  Yes. icobrain is **clinically validated with multiple peer-reviewed studies**, and certain modules
  have **regulatory clearance** where applicable, ensuring reliability in clinical practice.
* 06
  
  ### How does icobrain improve MRI reporting accuracy and efficiency?
  
  By automating detection and quantification, icobrain **reduces human error, saves radiologists
  time**, and provides objective metrics that improve **reporting accuracy and decision-making**.

## Frequently asked questions
* 01
  
  ### What is icometrix and what solutions does it offer?
  
  icometrix provides **AI-powered brain imaging solutions** for neurological disorders. Its
  portfolio is designed to help improve care in dementia and Alzheimer’s disease, multiple
  sclerosis, ARIA detection, brain trauma, stroke, epilepsy, tumors, and Parkinson’s disease.. The
  icometrix solutions **automatically detect, segment, and quantify brain structures and lesions**
  to support clinicians and researchers.
* 02
  
  ### How does icobrain AI help in brain imaging for neurological disorders?
  
  icobrain performs **automated detection and volumetric quantification** of lesions and brain
  structures, enabling clinicians to **monitor disease progression, evaluate treatment response, and
  make informed decisions**.
* 03
  
  ### Which neurological conditions can be analyzed with icobrain?
  
  icobrain supports analysis for **dementia & Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, stroke, traumatic
  brain injury, epilepsy, Parkinson’s disease, brain tumors, and ARIA monitoring**
* 04
  
  ### How does icobrain integrate with hospital workflows and PACS/EMR systems?
  
  Using **icobridge**, icobrain connects MRI scanners, PACS, and EMR systems. This enables **secure
  data transfer, automated report generation**, and clinician-friendly dashboards, streamlining the
  workflow.
* 05
  
  ### Is icobrain FDA-cleared or clinically validated?
  
  Yes. icobrain is **clinically validated with multiple peer-reviewed studies**, and certain modules
  have **regulatory clearance** where applicable, ensuring reliability in clinical practice.
* 06
  
  ### How does icobrain improve MRI reporting accuracy and efficiency?
  
  By automating detection and quantification, icobrain **reduces human error, saves radiologists
  time**, and provides objective metrics that improve **reporting accuracy and decision-making**.

## Welcome to Integrated Molecular Solutions ("IMS")

The mission of IMS is to offer a broad scope, focused platform solution for molecular medicine that
is adaptable in an ever-evolving dynamic field. This enables us to deliver top-tier Diagnostic
Imaging and Therapy Solutions to your practice. Our programs are turnkey, encompassing
implementation, construction, financing/leasing of diagnostic, theranostic, and oncologic systems.
These include PET/CT, SPECT/CT, Linear Accelerators, Radiosurgery systems, and Cyclotrons, enhancing
access to cutting-edge care in Oncologic, Cardiac, Urologic, Neurologic, and other medical specialty
areas.

[Learn More ][24]
[products slider BG]

## Products & Solutions

[Aurora-RT.jpg]
[home-galaxy-rtx1.jpg]
[The-diagram-of-components-in-the-linac-The-gantry-is-rotated-to-deliver-the-radiation.png]

## Products & Solutions

## About Us

Our model allows for centers to update and expand their treatment delivery options by moving from a
Capital Expenditure (CapEx) model to an Operational Expenditure (OpEx) model, a paradigm-changer for
centers and hospitals to have access to the latest technologies and stay non-obsolescent in an
ever-evolving world of healthcare.

LEARN MORE
[Learn More ][25]
[AdobeStock_882090941.jpeg]
LEARN MORE
[Learn More ][26]

### The Solution

We also extend our expertise in setting up a full-service imaging, theranostic, and radio-pharmacy
production program for your institution. Our plan includes the provision of state-of-the-art
diagnostic imaging equipment and production means for all radiopharmaceuticals across the
enterprise. All these are offered as a low capital expenditure partnership, making us a
cost-effective solution for your enterprise needs.

[AdobeStock_531824016.jpeg]

## The Integrated Molecular Solutions Difference

Integrated Molecular Solutions distinguishes itself by offering comprehensive turnkey
solutions across a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic service lines.  With a focus on
future isotope production, we ensure access to cutting-edge radiopharmaceuticals to meet evolving
clinical demands. Our state-of-the-art equipment supports precision diagnostics and advanced
treatment options, while robust clinical and revenue cycle support enhances operational efficiency
and financial performance.  By integrating innovative technology with end-to-end service offerings,
IMS positions itself as a leader in driving sustainable growth and superior patient outcomes.

# Precision In Neuroscience

## Advancing medicine through the provision of precision imaging biomarker insights for the
## discovery, development and delivery of novel treatments in neurological disease

[ IXI™ Platform ][59]
[ Services ][60]

## A global leader in neuroimaging and biomarker analytics

[ Company ][61]

IXI™ is IXICO’s proprietary, AI-enabled neuroimaging technology platform for precision medicine,
purpose-built to drive clinical trial imaging and biomarker science insights in neurological disease
research.

The Platform, combined with IXICO's expert clinical trial operations, helps accelerate
decision-making in clinical research and maximise the potential of drug development programmes.

## Neuroscience Expertise

IXICO has built a global reputation as a leading end-to-end Imaging Contract Research Organisation
(iCRO), expertly managing and analysing neurological clinical trials.

The Company is a key part of the global neurological disease research community, with a 20-year
proven track record in the biopharmaceutical industry, working with leading pharma companies,
innovative biotechs, scientific consortia, and non-profit organisations.

[ Therapeutic Expertise ][62]

## Differentiated Technology

[ IXI™ Platform ][63]

The IXI™ Platform is tailor-made for neurological diseases, reliably managing global clinical trial
data, precisely reading radiological scans, and measuring key imaging biomarkers linked to the
identification, progression, and treatment of conditions such as Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s, and
Parkinson’s disease.

# Precision In Neuroscience

## Advancing medicine through the provision of precision imaging biomarker insights for the
## discovery, development and delivery of novel treatments in neurological disease

[ IXI™ Platform ][59]
[ Services ][60]

## A global leader in neuroimaging and biomarker analytics

[ Company ][61]

IXI™ is IXICO’s proprietary, AI-enabled neuroimaging technology platform for precision medicine,
purpose-built to drive clinical trial imaging and biomarker science insights in neurological disease
research.

The Platform, combined with IXICO's expert clinical trial operations, helps accelerate
decision-making in clinical research and maximise the potential of drug development programmes.

## Neuroscience Expertise

IXICO has built a global reputation as a leading end-to-end Imaging Contract Research Organisation
(iCRO), expertly managing and analysing neurological clinical trials.

The Company is a key part of the global neurological disease research community, with a 20-year
proven track record in the biopharmaceutical industry, working with leading pharma companies,
innovative biotechs, scientific consortia, and non-profit organisations.

[ Therapeutic Expertise ][62]

## Differentiated Technology

[ IXI™ Platform ][63]

The IXI™ Platform is tailor-made for neurological diseases, reliably managing global clinical trial
data, precisely reading radiological scans, and measuring key imaging biomarkers linked to the
identification, progression, and treatment of conditions such as Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s, and
Parkinson’s disease.

# Defining the future of brain health

The only technology for accessible and evidence-based measurements of the brain.

[Experience it yourself][7]

## The core principles behind our products

### Actionable

Leveraging advanced algorithms to drive improvements in brain health and develop new interventions.

[Offer Kernel Scans at your clinic →][8]

### Science-backed

We lead with robust science and engage with leaders in the community.

[Read our publications →][9]

### Differentiated

A deep technology platform that both scales and breaks through the limitations of those that came
before.

[Learn more about the technology →][10]

## From brain data to insight

Kernel delivers detailed information about brain function by combining our non-invasive brain
measurements with algorithmic advances. You can now reliably track the performance of your brain.
1. Book a scan with one of our partner clinics
2. Get scanned in 30 minutes or less
3. Review your results with our user-friendly reports
4. Consult with your health team and see how interventions change your brain health

[Find a location][11][See what to expect][12]
[Platform]

## Follow your brain function over time

Unlike genetics, our brains are constantly changing and regular measurement is important to
understand what factors create the biggest changes in function.

Kernel's longitudinal reports let you visualize your cognitive health so you and your clinician can
track these changes, measure progress, and optimize interventions.

## Built for wellness and medicine

Discover our industry-leading tracer wellness products and learn more about our
upcoming marer medical products.

[Wellness]
[Wellness]

### Brain Agetracer

We track our step count and sleep quality, now you can track your brain health. Brain Age is an
objective measure of health built from thousands of scans.

[Book a scan with one of our clinics →][13]

### Cognitiontracer

The only cognitive tracker designed to assess healthy brains. Receive a detailed composition report
of key cognitive domains and see how your cognitive performance stacks up to others.

[Book a scan with one of our clinics →][14]

### Depressionmarer

Our depression study investigates whether brain activity can help predict if patients will respond
to TMS and Spravato® (esketamine) treatments. Early results suggest Kernel Flow may offer new
insights for selecting the right treatment for the right patient at the right time.

[Learn more about our ongoing work →][15]

### Cognitionmarer

In a published study, Kernel Flow successfully detected early patterns of brain activity associated
with mild cognitive impairment (MCI). This result highlights the platform's potential to support
early identification of cognitive decline in clinical settings. Additional studies are being planned
to assess more detailed profiles of cognitive performance in the context of disease diagnostics.

[Read our recent publication →][16]

### Research Opportunities

Want to participate in a paid research study that helps our team develop the next generation of
brain health tools?

[Visit KerneLabs to learn more →][17]

# Defining the future of brain health

The only technology for accessible and evidence-based measurements of the brain.

[Experience it yourself][7]

## The core principles behind our products

### Actionable

Leveraging advanced algorithms to drive improvements in brain health and develop new interventions.

[Offer Kernel Scans at your clinic →][8]

### Science-backed

We lead with robust science and engage with leaders in the community.

[Read our publications →][9]

### Differentiated

A deep technology platform that both scales and breaks through the limitations of those that came
before.

[Learn more about the technology →][10]

## From brain data to insight

Kernel delivers detailed information about brain function by combining our non-invasive brain
measurements with algorithmic advances. You can now reliably track the performance of your brain.
1. Book a scan with one of our partner clinics
2. Get scanned in 30 minutes or less
3. Review your results with our user-friendly reports
4. Consult with your health team and see how interventions change your brain health

[Find a location][11][See what to expect][12]
[Platform]

## Follow your brain function over time

Unlike genetics, our brains are constantly changing and regular measurement is important to
understand what factors create the biggest changes in function.

Kernel's longitudinal reports let you visualize your cognitive health so you and your clinician can
track these changes, measure progress, and optimize interventions.

## Built for wellness and medicine

Discover our industry-leading tracer wellness products and learn more about our
upcoming marer medical products.

[Wellness]
[Wellness]

### Brain Agetracer

We track our step count and sleep quality, now you can track your brain health. Brain Age is an
objective measure of health built from thousands of scans.

[Book a scan with one of our clinics →][13]

### Cognitiontracer

The only cognitive tracker designed to assess healthy brains. Receive a detailed composition report
of key cognitive domains and see how your cognitive performance stacks up to others.

[Book a scan with one of our clinics →][14]

### Depressionmarer

Our depression study investigates whether brain activity can help predict if patients will respond
to TMS and Spravato® (esketamine) treatments. Early results suggest Kernel Flow may offer new
insights for selecting the right treatment for the right patient at the right time.

[Learn more about our ongoing work →][15]

### Cognitionmarer

In a published study, Kernel Flow successfully detected early patterns of brain activity associated
with mild cognitive impairment (MCI). This result highlights the platform's potential to support
early identification of cognitive decline in clinical settings. Additional studies are being planned
to assess more detailed profiles of cognitive performance in the context of disease diagnostics.

[Read our recent publication →][16]

### Research Opportunities

Want to participate in a paid research study that helps our team develop the next generation of
brain health tools?

[Visit KerneLabs to learn more →][17]

## Liverpool Scholarships

There's still time to apply for a master's course starting in September 2026. Outstanding
international students could be eligible for one of our prestigious Liverpool Scholarships, worth up
to £9,000.

[Discover master's scholarships][154]

## Discover the University of Liverpool

[Victoria Gallery and Museum with University Square and students walking]

We are the University of Liverpool. Located at the heart of a thrilling world city, we are a dynamic
institution of academic excellence and innovation, making a positive impact across the United
Kingdom and the wider world.

Since 1881, we've been at the forefront of world-class research and education, known for our
cutting-edge facilities and relentless pursuit of excellence and achievement. Find out how you can
be part of our vibrant community and explore the work we’re doing with our famous home city.

[Learn about us][157] [Liverpool: Our city, our inspiration][158]
[Two students on campus, working together at a computer.]

## Study with us

Discover endless possibilities. We offer a range of courses with support and expertise to help you
succeed in your future career. Find your perfect course, explore our subject areas or discover
everything you need to know about studying with us.

[Undergraduate][159] [Master's][160] [Postgraduate research][161] [Continuing Professional
Development][162] [International students][163]

## Visit us on an Open Day

Explore our campus and learn more about what it's like to live and study at Liverpool with our Open
Days.

[Book your place][164]
[A person looking into the camera and smiling. They are wearing a pink hooded sweatshirt.]

## Get ahead of the crowd

If you’re a UK or Republic of Ireland student, you can start your application from 3pm on Tuesday 11
August and submit it on Thursday 13 August. International students who have their results can apply
now.

[Explore Clearing][165]

## Our rankings and reputation

[QS World rankings logo]

### World Top 140

QS World University Rankings 2027 places us in the Top 140 global universities. We've moved up to
139th in the world, rising 8 places since last year and up from 165th in the 2025 rankings.

[The TEF 2023 Gold logo.]

### Teaching Gold

Our teaching is rated Gold, the highest level, by the Teaching Excellence Framework.

[The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026 top 20 badge]

### 18th in the UK

We've climbed 5 places to 18th in The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026.

[The Times Higher Education logo. Next to it, it says 'World University Rankings]

### World Top 150

We’re ranked in the top 150 universities globally in the Times Higher Education World University
rankings.

[ Explore our rankings and reputation ][166]
[Aerial view of the India campus buildings and courtyard]

## Discover Liverpool in Bengaluru

Take a first look at our new campus in Bengaluru as we look forward to welcoming our inaugural
cohort. Find out more about our new campus, which will strengthen existing partnerships, build new
connections and bring our world-class teaching and research to India.

[Find out more][167]

## Our research: Transforming lives, changing the world

Discover how our research is making a difference all over the world. As a founding member of the
Russell Group, research is the driving force behind our success, tackling real-world challenges to
have a positive impact on society and the world around us.
* [ Research frontiers ][168]
  
  Learn more about our research frontiers and how we're driving innovation in materials discovery,
  particle physics, therapeutics innovation, AI for life, and infection resilience to build a better
  future.
* [ Interdisciplinary Centre for Sustainability Research ][169]
  
  Explore our new Interdisciplinary Centre for Sustainability Research and find out how we're
  utilising a variety of skills and knowledge to find new developments in sustainability research.
* [ Our impact ][170]
  
  91% of our research is ranked world leading or internationally excellent (REF 2021). Find out how
  our researchers are improving the world we live in every day.

[ Explore our research ][171]
[Students walking past a building with a sign that reads Liverpool Guild of Students.]

## Discover a vibrant student life in Liverpool

Enjoy a fantastic student experience when you study with us. Explore the Guild of Students, learn
more about what’s happening in our amazing home city and discover your accommodation options.

[Student life at Liverpool][172] [Why choose Liverpool?][173] [Find your accommodation][174]
[A gold Foucault pendulum over a compass on a tiled floor.]

## We're making an impact across the globe

We’re proud to be part of a global community, where collaboration drives our success and impact
across the world. Find out more about our commitment to global engagement and how we’re making a
difference to the world.

[Explore our global partnerships][175] [Work with us][176]

#### [ From Compliance to Clinical Action: Fixing the Broken Loop in Post-Market Surveillance ][24]

By Aalap Patel, MS, CQE, CSSBB

Post-market surveillance (PMS) systems in the medical device industry have become increasingly
sophisticated in collecting complaints, monitoring adverse events, and generating regulatory
reports. However, many organizations still struggle to translate these insights into timely clinical
action and meaningful patient safety improvements. This article examines the growing disconnect
between regulatory reporting and operational decision-making, explores the challenges of signal
detection and prioritization, and outlines practical strategies for building closed-loop PMS systems
that improve patient safety outcomes and organizational responsiveness.

We are reshaping the field of functional brain imaging, with the aim of ensuring that every
scientific advancement translates into meaningful health outcomes for patients worldwide.

Assessing brain function in real-time with MEG supports clinicians and researchers to unravel the
mysteries of the human brain and improve the diagnosis and treatment of neurological conditions.

## About MEG technology

### **What is MEG?**

MEG identifies the very small magnetic fields when brain cells are active, to detect and record
normal and abnormal brain activity in “real time.” MEG can localize brain function to within a
centimeter or even millimeters of the activity. MEG adds to the hemodynamic data obtained from MR
technology.

### **Comfortable patient experience**

It is entirely non-invasive, silent, and with no applied magnetic fields, radiation or injections of
any kind.

### **Precise technology for clinical treatment planning**

MEG helps doctors locate normal brain activity inluding where the brain processes language, sensory,
and motor information to help plan surgical and non-surgical treatments. MEG is unaffected by the
skull and scalp, or hemodynamic data like MR.

## MEG is an important part of pre-surgical evaluation

MEG Maps™ is designed to push the boundaries of neuroscience by augmenting the performance
limitations of traditional MR imaging modalities, providing neuroscientists, neurologists and
oncologists with a more advanced and precise functional imaging tool.

MEG is used alongside other functional brain mapping methods, such as fMRI, PET, SPECT, and TMS, to
non-invasively provide clinicians with a more complete picture of the location of a patient’s normal
and abnormal brain activity. MEG can assist in the presurgical evaluation and treatment planning,
specifically the placement of intracranial EEG (iEEG).

## MEG is an important part of a research program

Thousands of patients are participating in clinical MEG studies focusing on epilepsy, brain tumors,
traumatic brain injuries, PTSD, stroke, dementias, Parkinson’s, and other neurodegenerative
disorders.

MEG can be a valuable tool in Phase I & III pharmaceutical drug development as it allows researchers
to gain insights into the neural mechanisms underlying the effects of a drug.

We are reshaping the field of functional brain imaging, with the aim of ensuring that every
scientific advancement translates into meaningful health outcomes for patients worldwide.

Assessing brain function in real-time with MEG supports clinicians and researchers to unravel the
mysteries of the human brain and improve the diagnosis and treatment of neurological conditions.

## Introducing our end-to-end solution:

## Our MEG solution is used by hospitals
## and research institutions worldwide

## About MEG technology

### **What is MEG?**

MEG identifies the very small magnetic fields when brain cells are active, to detect and record
normal and abnormal brain activity in “real time.” MEG can localize brain function to within a
centimeter or even millimeters of the activity. MEG adds to the hemodynamic data obtained from MR
technology.

### **Comfortable patient experience**

It is entirely non-invasive, silent, and with no applied magnetic fields, radiation or injections of
any kind.

### **Precise technology for clinical treatment planning**

MEG helps doctors locate normal brain activity inluding where the brain processes language, sensory,
and motor information to help plan surgical and non-surgical treatments. MEG is unaffected by the
skull and scalp, or hemodynamic data like MR.

## MEG is an important part of pre-surgical evaluation

MEG Maps™ is designed to push the boundaries of neuroscience by augmenting the performance
limitations of traditional MR imaging modalities, providing neuroscientists, neurologists and
oncologists with a more advanced and precise functional imaging tool.

MEG is used alongside other functional brain mapping methods, such as fMRI, PET, SPECT, and TMS, to
non-invasively provide clinicians with a more complete picture of the location of a patient’s normal
and abnormal brain activity. MEG can assist in the presurgical evaluation and treatment planning,
specifically the placement of intracranial EEG (iEEG).

## MEG is an important part of a research program

Thousands of patients are participating in clinical MEG studies focusing on epilepsy, brain tumors,
traumatic brain injuries, PTSD, stroke, dementias, Parkinson’s, and other neurodegenerative
disorders.

MEG can be a valuable tool in Phase I & III pharmaceutical drug development as it allows researchers
to gain insights into the neural mechanisms underlying the effects of a drug.
